subsystem.name: RuntimeObjectsAndCRTInfrastructure
subsystem.responsibility: Generic runtime-object plumbing reconstructed from Wave 007: per-type reference-count decrement wrappers, callback-style pass-through wrappers, an object copy-construct/vtable installer, trivial thiscall getters, and a large MSVC CRT infrastructure cluster covering SEH/C++ exception dispatch (global and local unwind, frame processing, handler stubs) and float-formatting/FPU-state/FPE dispatch. Also includes Win32 API wrappers (MoveFileA, IsProcessorFeaturePresent) and scalar math helpers.

summary: The packet contains 41 functions that divide into two large, defensible MSVC CRT clusters and several small GUESS clusters of generic runtime-object plumbing. The MSVCRTExceptionHandler cluster (0x00588864-0x0058A3B6) is the CRT SEH/C++ exception core: RtlUnwind-based global unwind, a scope-table local-unwind walker, the _except_handler3/4-style frame processor, a flag-gated handler, a C++ frame-handler trampoline, and SEH forwarding thunks. The MSVCRTFloatDispatcher cluster (0x0058BD8F-0x005906BB) is CRT float-to-string formatting and FPU/FPE dispatch (trandisp1/2, cintrindisp1/2, fassign, cfltcvt, fsave/frstor wrappers). The remaining functions form GUESS clusters: per-type reference-count decrement wrappers reading flag bytes in the 0x008D3E30-0x008D3E3D region, callback pass-through wrappers into the shared BooleanToIntConversion routine, a copy-construct/vtable-install initializer with its field getters, a processor-capability probe pair (FDIV-bug check plus dynamic IsProcessorFeaturePresent), and string helpers. Two functions (MoveFileA error-handling wrapper 0x005898D3 and fixed-argument wrapper 0x0058BC56) are standalone with unknown owners. Most semantic ownership remains UNKNOWN; the CRT clusters are the only DERIVED-anchored structure.

function_roles.role: Callback pass-through wrapper: forwards the code address of 0x00586F30 (cast to int) to the shared BooleanToIntConversion routine and returns its result.
Reference-count decrement wrapper forwarding to RefCountDecrementWithCheck; deterministic facts record a read of flag global 0x008D3E30 not visible in the raw body.

Copy-construct-style initializer: parses the source sub-structure at a2+4 via StructInitParse, copies three source fields into this+0x10/0x14/0x18, clears flag byte this+0x19, installs vtable 0x005B8C30 at this+0x0, returns this.
Byte getter returning this+0x18 unchanged; consumed by ShortComputation_a820 (0x0057A820).
Thiscall getter returning the dword at this+0x10 (this[4]); no side effects.
Reference-count decrement+cleanup wrapper forwarding to RefCountDecrementWithCleanup; reads flag global 0x008D3E35 per deterministic facts.
Reference-count decrement+check wrapper forwarding to RefCountDecrementWithCheck; reads flag global 0x008D3E34 per deterministic facts.
Single-expression wrapper around RefCountDecrementWithCleanup; deterministic facts record a read of flag global 0x008D3E39.
Single-expression wrapper around RefCountDecrementWithCheck; deterministic facts record a read of flag global 0x008D3E38.
Single-expression wrapper around RefCountDecrementWithCleanup; deterministic facts record a read of flag global 0x008D3E3D.
Callback pass-through wrapper: forwards the code address of 0x00587AB0 (cast to int) to the shared BooleanToIntConversion routine and returns its result.
Reference-count decrement wrapper forwarding to RefCountDecrementWithCheck; read of flag global 0x008D3E3C is not visible in this body and likely occurs in the callee.
CRT global-unwind helper: calls RtlUnwind(TargetFrame, &loc_58887C, 0, 0); used by ScriptFrameProcessor (0x0058895C) and LongjmpMSVCCRT (0x0058A770).
Flag-gated SEH handler: reads dword at this+0x4, tests bitmask 6; on flag-set stores a2 into *a4 and returns 3, otherwise returns 1.

CRT scope-table local-unwind core (_local_unwind): walks 3-dword scope entries from a1+0x8 with current trylevel a1+0xC, invoking each entry's registered unwind handler (guarded by a disposition word) until trylevel -1 or target a2.

CRT abnormal-termination probe: reads the TEB exception list head and, only when the head handler equals FlagCheckHandler (0x00588884), reports whether the second registration links back into the handler's saved parameter block; defaults to 0.
Jump stub (JUMPOUT to 0x588944) forwarding argument a1; real implementation and the read of unk_5E63D0 (0x005E63D0) live at the jump target.
State-recording helper (__userpurge): stores eax (a3) into unk_5E63D4, the dword at [a2+8] into unk_5E63D8, and frame pointer a2 into unk_5E63DC, then returns a3; reached from SEH/unwind paths.

MSVCRT SEH frame processor (__except_handler3/4 style): on exception flags at a1+4 it unwinds unconditionally; otherwise walks the scope table, evaluates filters, and on a match performs global unwind (0x00588864), local unwind (0x005888A6) and catch dispatch (0x0058893A).
_local_unwind dispatch wrapper: loads scope-frame pointer from this+0x18 and target trylevel from this+0x1C, passes both to MSVCRTSEHFrameUnwinder, returns its result.
Win32 MoveFileA wrapper with error handling: clears LastError on success, captures GetLastError on failure, routes the error through ErrorIDLookupTable (0x0058AF5C) and returns -1, else 0.
MSVC C++ exception dispatch entry point (__usercall): forwards its arguments plus three zero tail values to sub_593446 and returns the result; compiler-emitted frame-handler trampoline.
SEH exception-frame forwarding thunk: reorders five exception-frame arguments (a3, a1, a5) into sub_593C50 and returns its result; invoked from SEHWrapperAroundCRTFunctionCall (0x005938B4).
Compiler helper for 64-bit logical right shift (value in edx:eax, count in cl): returns 0 for count >= 64, else a1 >> a2; invoked by TextureDecodeRGB16 (0x0050A6E5).
Finite/non-finite predicate on the upper 16 bits of a2: returns TRUE when (HIWORD(a2) & 0x7FF0) != 0x7FF0; a1 unused; guards degenerate FP inputs.
Fixed-argument wrapper: forwards the constant literals 0x10000 and 196608 to sub_59508D and returns its result, likely configuring a fixed-size operation.
Constant-only FPU sanity probe computing 4195835.0 - (4195835.0 / 3145727.0) * 3145727.0 and returning (residual > 1.0); canonical Pentium FDIV-bug detection expression.

Dynamic IsProcessorFeaturePresent query: resolves the kernel32 export via GetModuleHandleA/GetProcAddress and calls it with feature id 0, falling back to the internal FDIV probe (0x0058BC68) when resolution fails.
Trims trailing zeros from the fractional part of a formatted float string and re-joins the exponent tail; uses the read-only decimal-separator global byte_5E6BD8.
Predicate returning TRUE when the double pointed to by the argument is >= 0.0 (compared against dbl_5B8CC8), else FALSE.

CRT long-double assignment helper (__fassign): on nonzero discriminator a1 materializes source a3 via BufferFormatHelper and stores both dwords; on zero parses in place via StringParseWithFormat and stores one dword; returns destination a2.

CRT float-to-string format dispatcher (cfltcvt): 'e'/'E' (101/69) routes to FloatToStringWithSignWidth (0x0058BDCD), 'f' (102) to IntToStringWithSignPositionDraw (0x0058BEF0), anything else to UtilityFunction_bfec (0x0058BFEC).

x87 assembler power primitive (LEGACY ABI lead x87_pow): compares |st0| against extended-precision constant tbyte_5E6C0E, branches on FPU status flags, applies f2xm1 on the non-compare path, returns result in st0.
x87 rounding/FPU-state control helper (LEGACY FloatRoundControl): rounds st0 via frndint and, on an already-integral input, multiplies by dbl_5E6C22 and rounds again; returns the original st0.
FPU-state wrapper: saves x87 state via fsave, calls sub_58DE2C with (a2, a1, buffer), restores via frstor, returns the first saved double, and calls SetByteFlag when the callee returned nonzero.

CRT float-display control-word and dispatch helper (trandisp1): selects FPU control word from format-mode byte at this+0xE, builds a dispatch byte via the unk_5E6C6C xlat table, and calls through the vtable at a1+16.
Structural twin of trandisp1 with a double xlat dispatch index ((4 * v13) | _AL) into the vtable at a1+16; also records caller state and an x87-stack value.

First-character-of-set helper: builds a 256-bit membership set from byte string a2 via _bittestandset, scans a1 via _bittest, and returns the first matching character (rendered by Hex-Rays as (byte)a1 - 1) or 0.
CRT intrinsic/FPE dispatch wrapper (cintrindisp2): forwards register-carried caller state and a local savedregs buffer to sub_58DAD7, then returns the result of sub_59070A.
CRT intrinsic/FPE dispatch wrapper (cintrindisp1): forwards register-carried caller state and a local savedregs buffer to trandisp1 (0x0058DA70), then calls sub_59070A with the saved FPU state.

CRT float-display wrapper (ctrandisp2): loads two doubles via CRTFload, forwards register-carried state and x87-stack doubles to sub_58DAD7, then calls sub_590703 on the savedregs buffer and returns its result.

classes.name: MSVCRTExceptionHandler
classes.responsibility: MSVC CRT structured- and C++-exception handling infrastructure: global unwind via RtlUnwind, scope-table local unwind, _except_handler3/4-style frame processing, flag-gated handler, state recording, and SEH/C++ dispatch trampolines. Compiler-emitted, not game logic.

classes.name: MSVCRTFloatDispatcher
classes.responsibility: MSVC CRT float-to-string formatting and FPU/FPE dispatch infrastructure: long-double assignment (fassign), float-format dispatch (cfltcvt), FPU control-word selection and vtable dispatch (trandisp1/2), FPU-state save/restore, and the intrinsic dispatch wrappers (cintrindisp1/2, ctrandisp2). Compiler/CRT machinery, not game logic.

classes.name: ScalarMathUtility
classes.responsibility: Small scalar math helpers used across the binary: a 64-bit shift-right compiler helper, a finite/non-finite predicate, a non-negative-double predicate, and an x87 power primitive. Membership is by shape, not by proven common source ownership.

classes.name: ReferenceCountController
classes.responsibility: Per-type reference-count decrement wrappers that forward to shared RefCountDecrementWithCheck/Cleanup routines; each reads a per-type flag byte in the 0x008D3E30-0x008D3E3D region (flag reads attested by deterministic facts but not visible in the raw bodies).

classes.name: CallbackRegistry
classes.responsibility: Zero-argument wrappers that forward a target function's code address to the shared BooleanToIntConversion routine (0x00587B3E), consistent with a callback/registration pass-through; the semantic role of the shared callee is unconfirmed.

classes.name: ConfigCopyConstruct
classes.responsibility: Object whose copy-construction copies a small config record (dwords at 0x10/0x14, bytes at 0x18/0x19) from a source object, parses an embedded sub-structure, and installs vtable 0x005B8C30; the two trivial getters read the same field offsets and are grouped here by shape with GUESS trust on common ownership.

classes.name: ProcessorCapabilityProbe
classes.responsibility: Processor-capability detection: the constant-only Pentium FDIV-bug probe (4195835.0 / 3145727.0 residual) and the dynamic IsProcessorFeaturePresent query that falls back to it. Grouped by the fallback relationship.

classes.name: CrtStringHelper
classes.responsibility: Free string utilities: trailing-zero trim of a formatted float string (using the read-only decimal-separator global byte_5E6BD8) and a first-character-of-set search over two byte strings.

transitions.guard: current trylevel at this+0xC is neither -1 nor the target level a2
scope entry's disposition word allows continuing to the next trylevel
current trylevel equals the target level a2
current trylevel equals -1 (no enclosing scope left)

interfaces.name: RefCountDecrementPath
interfaces.purpose: Per-object-type wrappers that forward to a shared RefCountDecrementWithCheck/Cleanup routine and gate on per-type flag bytes in the 0x008D3E30-0x008D3E3D region; a replacement must preserve one entry point per object type.

interfaces.name: CrtFloatDisplayDispatch
interfaces.purpose: CRT float-display/FPE dispatch family (trandisp1/2, cintrindisp1/2, ctrandisp2): select FPU control word, translate a format byte through the unk_5E6C6C table, and dispatch through the vtable at a1+16.

interfaces.name: CallbackRegistrationSink
interfaces.purpose: Zero-argument wrappers forwarding a target function's code address into the shared BooleanToIntConversion routine (0x00587B3E); the wrappers are attested, the sink's semantics are not.

compatibility_contracts.name: CRTSehFrameContract
compatibility_contracts.description: MSVC _except_handler3/4 SEH frame layout must be preserved: exception-record flags at frame+0x4 (bits 1-2 trigger unconditional unwind), scope-table pointer at frame+0x8, current trylevel at frame+0xC (3-dword scope entries), and the RtlUnwind(TargetFrame, loc_58887C, 0, 0) global-unwind protocol. A replacement executable that wants to coexist with or replace this CRT path must match this layout and the -1/target-trylevel termination semantics.

compatibility_contracts.name: CrtFpuControlWordSelection
compatibility_contracts.description: CRT float-display helpers install specific x87 control words selected by the format-mode byte at object+0xE (mode 5 selects control word 63, otherwise 4927) before vtable dispatch. Any replacement of the float-formatting path must reproduce this control-word selection and the unk_5E6C6C xlat-table dispatch so formatted output matches.

compatibility_contracts.name: CrtFloatFormatDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: Float-to-string conversion dispatches on the format code: 'e'/'E' to the scientific formatter, 'f' to the fixed-point formatter, everything else to the default helper. A replacement must preserve these format-code routing semantics to reproduce rendered float text.

compatibility_contracts.name: ProcessorCapabilityDetection
compatibility_contracts.description: Initialization queries a processor feature flag via dynamically resolved IsProcessorFeaturePresent(feature id 0) and falls back to the constant-only FDIV probe (4195835.0 / 3145727.0 residual > 1.0). A replacement must reproduce the same capability signal so feature-dependent code paths behave identically.

compatibility_contracts.name: MoveFileErrorContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The MoveFileA wrapper reports failures: returns 0 on success (LastError cleared), and on failure captures GetLastError, routes it through ErrorIDLookupTable, and returns -1. A replacement file-operation layer must preserve this success/error signalling contract for the caller at 0x004B0770.

compatibility_contracts.name: RefCountPerTypeFlagRegion
compatibility_contracts.description: Seven per-type reference-count decrement wrappers read flag bytes in the contiguous 0x008D3E30-0x008D3E3D region. If these bytes gate reference-count semantics per object type, a replacement must reproduce the same per-type flag layout; the exact layout is unproven.

unresolved: BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) applied to a function pointer is semantically unexplained; the callback-registration reading is a shape-based GUESS, not proven.
RefCountDecrementWithCheck/Cleanup are named only in raw source text and absent from the packet callee list, so their target addresses and exact reference-counting semantics are unknown.

The 0x008D3E30-0x008D3E3D byte flags form an apparent per-type refcount-flag region but their reads are recorded by deterministic facts, not visible in the raw bodies; the mechanism (argument setup, inlined prologue, thunk linkage) is unknown.
The vtable installed at 0x005B8C30 is shared with ObjectInitWithVTableSetup (0x00587030, outside this packet); the class identity behind it is unverified.
The copy-construct fields (this+0x10/0x14/0x18/0x19) have no confirmed semantics, and whether getters 0x00587210/0x0058730C belong to the same class is a GUESS based on shared offsets.
StructInitParse (0x00587490) purpose is not in the packet.
Global 0x0058A40A is flagged as read in 0x0058A3B6 but appears nowhere in its raw body; the read may belong to inlined or optimized-away code.
dword_5E9AD0 (CrtFPEExceptionFlag, DERIVED) is read by the 0x00590640/0x0059067E dispatch paths but does not appear directly in their raw source snippets.
The decompiler leaves registers v4 (edx) in 0x005906BB and v9 (ecx) in 0x0058895C uninitialized; the register-carrying contracts around them are not fully recovered.
tbyte_5E6BF0 is referenced by X87Pow (0x0058D9BE) but has no packet globals entry or evidence ref; its value is unknown.
The 257 code passed to sub_58893A and the disposition dword in the scope-table entry are unexplained; full scope-table layout is not established.
FDIV-probe literal-to-global mapping (which double lives at 0x005B8C80/0x005B8D48/0x005B8D50) is not evidenced; the interpretation is DERIVED.
FindFirstCharInSet's return value is a Hex-Rays degradation ((byte)a1 - 1) of an apparently pointer-returning strpbrk-like helper; its consumption by 0x00588A34 is unknown.
The 0x0058FC60 field:this:0x00000000 prelabel is a spurious getter artifact; the function is __cdecl with two pointer arguments and no 'this' object.
JumpStub 0x00588931 forwards to 0x588944 outside this packet; unk_5E63D0 (0x005E63D0) read is likely consumed at the jump target.
The two adjacent globals stores of StoreInterpreterState (0x0058893A) form a small context record but their role and the object behind pointer a2 are unproven.
Why fixed-argument wrapper 0x0058BC56 and query 0x0058BCA6 both route through InitWrapperCalling3Subroutines (0x00587B7F) is outside this packet.
The purpose of literals 0x10000 and 196608 passed to sub_59508D is unknown.
dbl_5E6C22 in FloatRoundControl and the FPU-control/rounding-state effect of that helper are unproven.
Whether the FPU-state save/restore in 0x0058DA35 serves reentrancy or ABI isolation is unknown, and SetByteFlag's target flag is unidentified.
